items.description: In Bayahaaw village, on the outskirts of Jowhar in central Somalia, farmers face a difficult choice: plant crops and risk losing them to floodwaters or leave their fields bare and face potential hunger in the coming year. items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 29 OTT - The shareholders of Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on Thursday rejected a proposal for the bank to merge with Mediobanca. The proposal needed the support of two-thirds of the bank's capital to be approved, but 63.65% voted against, with only 32.91% in favour and 3.42% abstaining. The merger was part of CEO Luigi Lovaglio's plan to fend off a 33-billion-euro takeover ‌bid by Intesa Sanpaolo for MPS. items.titleIt: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca
